mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the past month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the past two months signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in the past month, combined with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a mismatch in labor market dynamics, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 300k and UNRATE also increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the past month, combined with a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS), signals a tightening of consumer spending and monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with consumer spending decline
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS decreases by more than 1% and FEDFUNDS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in the past month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the past two months signals a strengthening housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 5%.
